name: 水胶体隐形夜间痘痘贴款
description: 夜间贴睡吸痘护痘，隔绝手抠防留印，轻薄透明隐形不闷痘

styleLock.direction: clinical-clean acne-care commerce: white and warm off-white paper panels punctuated by bold organic brand-red blocks, real skin texture for pain and mechanism proof
styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white seamless for packshots; warm off-white paper panels for content pages; low-saturation pink gradients for on-face scenes; deep-red gradient curtain #8E1414 to #C22A20 reserved exclusively for the trust finale
styleLock.lightingSystem: large frontal-top diffused softbox with zero hard shadows, subtle contact shadows only, transmitted backlight to reveal the patch translucency
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless paper and matte white acrylic; real unretouched skin as the surface for close-ups; velvet curtain pedestal only on the trust finale
styleLock.typography: ultra-bold geometric sans-serif headlines in near-black or pure white, one message per frame, thin supporting body
styleLock.iconSystem: red circular checkmarks, black-and-white numbered round badges connected by dotted paths, white dotted focus rings, thin callout lines
styleLock.presentationRules: the patch is always the focal point or highlighted by a white dotted focus ring; skin texture stays real without smoothing
noDrift: no teal or blue-purple sub-brand colors
no hard light or heavy shadows
no brand logos or packaging copy
no fabricated certifications, rankings or sales numbers
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: clinical-clean acne-care commerce built on a pure white seamless base #FFFFFF and warm off-white paper panels #F5F1E9, punctuated by bold organic brand-red blocks #E8402A with coral accents #F08072; the deep-red gradient curtain #8E1414 to #C22A20 with a round pedestal is reserved exclusively for the trust finale. Lighting is always soft - large frontal-top diffused key, zero hard shadows, subtle contact shadows, transmitted backlight for the patch translucency. Ultra-bold geometric sans headlines in near-black #1A1A1A or pure white, one message per frame. Icon language: red circular checkmarks, numbered round badges on dotted paths, white dotted focus rings, thin callout lines. Real unretouched skin carries the pain and mechanism close-ups with the patch razor sharp at focus. Never introduce teal or blue-purple sub-brand colors, never show brand logos or original packaging copy, never fabricate certifications, rankings or sales claims, never use hard light or over-smoothed skin.

shots.intent: 首屏点击：白盒正面加背面衬纸，红弧色块建立识别，规格清晰
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight downward tilt, box standing upright slightly left, one patch backing sheet leaning at the right rear
shots.lighting: soft top plus front-left softbox, no hard shadows
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Straight-on eye-level packshot with a slight downward tilt: the box stands upright slightly left of center, one translucent patch backing sheet leans at the right rear, a bold red arc graphic across the upper box face. Soft top and front-left softbox light, no hard shadows. Pure white seamless background #FFFFFF. Product occupies 60-65% of frame. No overlaid text. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no brand logos, no fake certification marks, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 痛点命中：真实痘点加贴片被白虚线圈注，大字喊出一贴见效
shots.camera: close-up of a generic model's lower face at eye level with a slight side tilt, pimple and patch at the upper-right third, framed tight
shots.lighting: large soft frontal-top diffused light, pores and blemish clearly visible without retouching
shots.background: real warm-brown skin #B97A5E filling the frame, one coral organic color block #F08072 at the lower left
shots.props: fingertip lightly pointing at the patch
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce pain-point close-up for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Tight close-up of a generic model's lower face, a whitehead pimple with a translucent patch applied, both highlighted by a hand-drawn white dotted focus ring; the fingertip points at the patch. Large soft frontal-top diffused light, unretouched skin texture, no hard shadows. Skin #B97A5E fills the frame, one coral organic block #F08072 anchors the lower left. Bottom oversized white 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no identifiable face, no diseased or exaggerated wounds, no brand logos, no watermark, no extra text, no over-smoothed skin.

shots.intent: 卖点落地：指尖贴于痘点，展示轻薄透明与防抠挤
shots.camera: eye-level three-quarter medium close-up of a generic model, person occupying the right two thirds, hand action toward the chin
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. Lifestyle scene of {product} in use. {product_identity_lock}. Eye-level three-quarter medium close-up of a generic bare-faced model, the right two thirds of frame, a fingertip pressing a translucent patch onto a chin blemish. Soft frontal-top window light, gentle shadows. Left-side short white 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no identifiable face, no brand logos, no watermark, no dense text, no harsh shadows.

shots.intent: 机制可感：用后贴片白色吸出物微距，直观证明水胶体吸附
shots.camera: macro at eye level with shallow depth of field, fingertips holding the used patch in the upper half, split layout with a white text panel below
shots.lighting: soft side key with specular highlights, warm blurred background bokeh
shots.background: blurred warm skin tone #D9A88C above, pure white #FFFFFF text panel below
shots.props: fingertips and one used patch showing a white absorbed residue dot
shots.promptTemplate: {style_lock}. E-commerce mechanism proof macro for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. Upper half: macro of fingertips holding one used translucent patch with a small white absorbed-residue dot clearly visible, shallow depth of field, blurred warm skin bokeh #D9A88C. Lower half: clean pure white #FFFFFF panel. Soft side key with delicate specular highlights. Patch is the 15% focal point, lower half. Negative: no gross-out imagery, no exaggerated medical claims, no brand logos, no watermark, no identifiable features, no dense text.

shots.intent: 材质细节：指甲揭膜动作加透明边缘高光，证明轻薄随肤

shots.lighting: soft front-side light catching the translucent edge of the patch
shots.background: blurred red #D93B2B and milky white #F5F0EB bokeh blocks

shots.props: three red circular checkmark icons, one red capsule badge
